title: Capability
description: A behaviour the application offers, expressed in domain terms ('apply_coupon') rather than DOM terms ('click button #apply'). The layer that lets an agent reason about intent, and the layer a test writes against.

name.description: Stable snake_case verb phrase: login, logout, search_product, add_product_to_cart, remove_product_from_cart, apply_coupon, submit_order, change_shipping_address.

kind.description: query reads state, setup prepares state (login, seed data), composite is a capability built from other capabilities.

assertions.description: Postconditions that should hold once the capability succeeded.

element.description: Shorthand for a single-element capability. Equivalent to one step.

steps.description: How to realise the capability in the UI. Ordered, deterministic. Values may reference input parameters with {{param}} placeholders. Optional in v0.1: inferred from transitions when absent.

composed_of.description: For kind=composite: the capabilities this one is built from, in order.

aliases.description: Alternative names seen in the UI or in analytics events.

value.description: Literal value or "{{param}}" template bound to an input parameter.

optional.description: True when the step may legitimately be skipped (dismissible banner, cookie notice).
